title: Modulation of the directions of the anisotropic axes of DyIII ions through utilizing two kinds of organic ligands or replacing DyIII ions by FeIII ions

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Dy4(NO3)(HL)4{(py)2C(OH)O}2](OH)·6CH3CN·0.5H2O (H3L = 2-((2-hydroxybenzylidene)amino)propane-1,3-diol; (py)2C(OH)2 = gem-diol form of di-2-pyridyl ketone); anal. C74H82Dy4N15O20.50

material_class.structural_family: irregular tetrahedral Dy4 cluster with unprecedented η4,η1,η1,μ4-nitrate

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.0438 g, 0.1 mmol), di-2-pyridyl ketone (0.0368 g, 0.2 mmol), H3L (0.0390 g, 0.2 mmol) and triethylamine (0.0608 g, 0.6 mmol) were stirred in acetonitrile (20 mL) for 1.5 h at room temperature. The bright yellow solution was filtered. Colorless crystals formed by slow evaporation after 20 days, were washed three times with Et2O and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic stirring then filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter bright yellow solution; colorless crystals by slow solvent evaporation; wash three times with Et2O; dry in air

properties.summary: SMM-like slow magnetic relaxation without χ″ peaks. χMT at 300 K is 56.10 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 56.48 for four free DyIII). χMT decreases to 42.62 at 25 K and 21.56 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K, indicating overall antiferromagnetic Dy–Dy coupling at low T. Magnetization at 7 T is 20.34 μB, far below 40 μB saturation. Zero-field ac χ″ is observed without peaks; Ueff = 8.73 K and τ0 = 6.8 × 10−7 s from ln(χ″/χ′) vs T−1. Magellan analysis: easy axes of the four DyIII ions are not directed toward the μ4-nitrate O17.

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; fit of ln(χ″/χ′) = ln(ωτ0) + Ueff/kBT

measurements.name: τ0
measurements.conditions: zero dc field, same high-frequency ac fit

source_locations.location: Experimental section, Preparation of complexes 1 and 2

material_class.structural_family: Fe4Dy2 cluster containing an irregular Fe2Dy2 tetrahedron capped by two additional FeIII

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, FeCl3·6H2O (0.0542 g, 0.2 mmol), Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.0438 g, 0.1 mmol), H3L (0.0390 g, 0.2 mmol), di-2-pyridyl ketone (0.0368 g, 0.2 mmol), tetramethylammonium hydroxide pentahydrate (0.1087 g, 0.6 mmol) and NaN3 (0.013 g, 0.2 mmol) were stirred in acetonitrile (20 mL) for 80 min at room temperature. The dark red slightly turbid solution was filtered. Yellow crystals formed by slow evaporation after one week, were washed three times with Et2O and dried in air.
synthesis.time: stirred 80 min; crystals after one week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic stirring then filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter dark red slightly turbid solution; yellow crystals by slow solvent evaporation; wash three times with Et2O; dry in air

properties.summary: Field-induced slow magnetic relaxation without χ″ peaks. χMT at 300 K is 44.54 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 45.84 for four HS FeIII plus two DyIII). χMT decreases to 33.36 at 18 K, rises to 34.41 at 3.5 K (overall ferromagnetic coupling), then falls to 33.12 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 7 T is 19.71 μB. Zero-field ac χ″ is negligible (QTM); under 1500 Oe, Ueff = 13.80 K and τ0 = 8.54 × 10−7 s. Magellan: DyIII easy axes are nearly parallel.
